description:
Owner-only decision gate for the Theseus extraction (move the oracle reviewer out of BenchBox into BenchBox-dev/theseus).

The reviewed proposal adds four obligations a separate repository needs and an in-BenchBox package does not: new BenchBox promotion-review behaviour, a vendored matcher module, a second gateway client and App, and two trusted resolutions (reviewer and gate) in the publish path. The alternative is a package boundary inside BenchBox (same module boundary, none of those obligations, no OSS reuse).

Options:
(a) Proceed with BenchBox-dev/theseus.
(b) Package inside BenchBox instead; drop every theseus-* item with this reason and create one successor item for the in-repo package.
(c) Stop extraction entirely; drop every theseus-* item.

Guardrails: an agent must not answer this item, infer an answer from earlier sessions, or finish it without the owner's answer in a current user message.
